reviews.x: This worked perfectly well for me! No complaints here! Cleans my brushes really well AND FAST! Easy to use. I'd recommend to a friend.
Hace lo que promete, limpia tus brochas con facilidad. Las deja casi secas para el próximo uso. Lo recomiendo
Loved it.  It worked fantastic.  Never knew there was so much make on the brushes.  And I clean my brushes regularly.  In less than a minute cleaned and almost dry.  Would definitely recommend it.
This is amazing! So easy to use and cleans and dries my brushes in a jiff. Certainly helps make it easier to clean my brushes regularly

Wow - this brush cleaner is a must-have! Simple to put together and comes with everything you need to start cleaning right away. My brushes are super clean in a fraction of what it used to take to clean them. I love it!

reviews.t: So easy to clean your brushes love it!
reviews.x: I really liked this product. It makes cleaning my make up brushes so much easier. The only complaint I have is that I have some cheap brushes and just shead some light on that. Need to invest in better quality brushes

My gf asked for a makeup brush cleaner for Christmas. I researched several, and arrived on this one. They all seemed to be basically the same to me. Brush spinner, adapters to hold different size brushes, and a bowl. This one has a plastic bowl, and hence the cheaper price. It also does not come with any sort of solution, so she bought her own. She says she likes the product, and has cleaned all of her brushes with it.

This little guy is with no doubt the best way to clean your brushes!! I could not believe how fast it cleans and dries my brushes! No more waiting hours and hours for my brushes to dry. I love love love it!  I recommend it to anyone!
Seems a little cheaply made and the brushes are very hard to get into the sleeves

This was not what I expected at all. With bigger brushes, such as my all face powder brush, it struggles to spin. Even with smaller brushes such as an angled bronzing brush, there was still a lot of product left on the bristles. None of my brushes were cleaned. Very disappointed with my purchase.
The product works great on smaller brushes. IIr did a fabulous job with them just like it advertises. Larger brushes just fall off and you could do the same thing by just washing them yourself

reviews.t: Life changing! Brushes clean and dry
reviews.x: This product is life changing! It gets the brushes cleaner than you could by hand and whirls the water out for fast drying. So happy! No more scrubbing on silicone pad and rinsing over and over and over to remove soap and then waiting forever for brushes to dry.

reviews.t: A little awkward to use but efficient
reviews.x: Worked okay for my brushes. Not great for non water soluble makeup to be removed from brushes. But still more efficient than trying to hand wash my brush. Would recommend this product to others

reviews.t: Works OK, but expected more power.
reviews.x: Yes it works. Much faster than what I've been doing, but not completely effective on large foundation brushes. This didn't get biger brushes clean anywhere close to the feral. I went with this product because it had good reviews. I found the motor to be pretty weak. Unable to spin large to medium brushes when bristles where in the water. I had to dip and lift. Also I ended up using a soap tray with a bumpy bottom to agitate the brushes as they spun to get the brushes clean.

I’ve been using this brush cleaner regularly for my foundation brush, and the brush stays dirty and wet. I allowed my brush to soak in soapy water and it still didn’t come clean. The photo here shows how dirty my brush was after two spins through the soapy water.

Overall, good product.  Id purchase again if needed. I do wish it came with an attachment for very slim brushes, the thinnest one still sent my one brush flying. All my other brushes I cleaned stayed put in their pieces though. It seems a bit wobbly when you attach them to the "machine" but its actually pretty sturdy. Id say it got my foundation brush 80% clean, which is what I do by hand but in a lot more time and horrific mess so ill call it a win. Reduced cleaning time significantly. Easy to

Ok so i have a love hate relationship with this thing. First off its small so i like it cuz it won't take up much space. It's very easy to use. However, its super sensitive. The wand fell to the floor off my bed and is usless now. I wish it was more sturdier. Plus when i did get to use it, it did not penetrate all the way through my kabuki foundation brush. For smaller brushes its a dream but for larger ones it only gets the surface.

reviews.t: Spindle does not stay in spinning hand held device
reviews.x: I am not sure if the one I got is defective or not.  I wanted to love this but I don’t.  The spindle will not stay in the device and so the brush just flies out of the part you hold.  If the metal spindle would actually stay in the part that makes it spin this would be an amazing product.  It doesn’t though and it’s very disappointing.

reviews.t: does not come with any cleaning fluid
reviews.x: this is a handy gadget that i will definitely use. it doesn't say what kind of make up cleanser to use which i would have found helpful. i used baby shampoo with my powder brushes and they look clean and smell good. also, dried very well. my concealer brush did not come clean but that's because i don't know what to use to clean it.

I would have loved to give more stars. I don’t know if mine is defective, but the actual piece that holds the brush keeps detaching from the actual handle and I just end up with a wet, dirty brush submerged in water. I can’t get through cleaning even my lightest (in weight) brush without it popping off.

I bought this for my sister and these are her exact words. “I like the make up brush cleaner. It has a lot of different attachments for the spin part but I only need to use 2. Since my brush handles are virtually the same. So quick and you can see all the makeup cleaning off of it in the tank. So cool!”

reviews.t: Easy to use but will come apart if not careful.
reviews.x: While this device does make washing your brushes easier, the fact that the spindle peg does not go flush into the device means you have to make sure to hold it firmly straight up, otherwise it will come out. I will keep it because it was inexpensive and it does help a ton with cleaning my brushes.

It came with batteries that were dented up and over a year past their expiration date. Also, I didn't even have a makeup brush attached yet and the motor was really slow. Not worth the time it will take to pack it up again and return it, and it definitely doesn't clean the way they state it would.

So the handle of the brushes don't fit every rubber thingie that is supposed to hold them. BUT I just taped them to the rubber holder and it was fine. It worked well to get the brushes clean, and dry as well. I had no complaints there just that the rubber holders aren't universal. Which is fine.

I Really like the product, I give it a total of 4 out of 5 stars. Only because the bigger/heavier brush kept popping out, the actual spindle kept coming out with brush. But I was still able to use just had to keep pushing it back in, all my other brushes were no problem. Cleaned them well.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cleaner easy to use and effective at cleaning brushes quickly.
Several reviewers praise how fast it dries brushes, leaving them almost dry for the next use.
A common complaint is that it struggles with larger brushes, which fall off or don't get clean.
Some reviewers mention the product feels cheaply made or has awkward brush sleeves.
Some reviewers note it is less effective on certain makeup types or leaves product behind.
